bagPolicy.summary: Bags must measure 18 × 14 × 9 inches or smaller and are searched at entry. Hiking backpacks, suitcases and other oversized bags are prohibited.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Kings Theatre recommends public transit, taxi or rideshare because nearby street parking is limited.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Kings Theatre recommends taxi, Uber or Lyft for arrival but does not designate a pickup or drop-off curb.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: The theatre prohibits outside food and drinks except medical exemptions; contact the venue before the event about an exemption.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Kings Theatre has an official accessibility assistance page and contact for accommodations; check available seating and facilities before booking.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Kings Theatre enforces a no re-entry rule.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Collect will-call tickets at the theatre box office beginning 60 minutes before advertised showtime. The box office does not accept third-party will call.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Everyone passes security screening that can include metal detectors, visual inspection and bag searches. The box office opens two hours before advertised showtime, but the venue does not publish a universal door time.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
